text:
Thinking the road ran straight,

I came to such misfortune

that I cannot imagine, even in madness,

anything that might satisfy me for a moment.


The open field seems narrow to me;

the clear night is dark;

sweet company, bitter and harsh,

and the bed, a hard field of battle.


Of sleep, if any comes, that part alone

which is the image of death

suits my weary soul.


In short, however things may be, I am so placed

that I already judge a less painful hour

by the one in which I saw what is a sword.

translation.title: Thinking the road ran straight...
